arxiv-1511-04363.title: Dynamics of z n + 1 = α + α ​ z n + β ​ z n − 1 1 + z n \displaystyle{z_{n+1}=\frac{\alpha+\alpha z_{n}+\beta z_{n-1}}{1+z_{n}}} in Complex Plane
arxiv-1511-04363.creator: Sk. Sarif Hassan
arxiv-1511-04363.description: Abstract The dynamics of the second order rational difference equation z n + 1 = α + α ​ z n + β ​ z n − 1 1 + z n \displaystyle{z_{n+1}=\frac{\alpha+\alpha z_{n}+\beta z_{n-1}}{1+z_{n}}} with complex parameters α \alpha , β \beta and arbitrary complex initial conditions is investigated.

arxiv-2102-07051.title: Maximum Energy Growth Rate in Dilute Quantum Gases
arxiv-2102-07051.creator: Ran Qi, Zheyu Shi, Hui Zhai
arxiv-2102-07051.description: Abstract In this letter we study how fast the energy density of a quantum gas can increase in time, when the inter-atomic interaction characterized by the s s -wave scattering length a s a_{\text{s}} is increased from zero with arbitrary time dependence.

arxiv-2207-06483.title: Multiple Solutions for Nonlinear Generalized-Kirchhoff type potential Systems in Unbounded Domains
arxiv-2207-06483.creator: Nabil Chems Eddine and Anass Ouannasser
arxiv-2207-06483.description: Abstract . In this paper, we consider a class of quasilinear stationary Kirchhoff type potential systems in unbounded domains, which involves a general variable exponent elliptic operator. Under some suitable conditions on the nonlinearities, we establish existence of at least three weak solutions for the problem.

arxiv-2209-00906.title: Instance-Dependent Noisy Label Learning via Graphical Modelling
arxiv-2209-00906.creator: Arpit Garg, Cuong Nguyen, Rafael Felix, Thanh-Toan Do, Gustavo Carneiro
arxiv-2209-00906.description: Abstract Noisy labels are unavoidable yet troublesome in the ecosystem of deep learning because models can easily overfit them. There are many types of label noise, such as symmetric, asymmetric and instance-dependent noise (IDN), with IDN being the only type that depends on image information.

arxiv-2302-09796.title: Fast Algorithms via Dynamic-Oracle Matroids
arxiv-2302-09796.creator: Joakim Blikstad, Sagnik Mukhopadhyay, Danupon Nanongkai, Ta-Wei Tu
arxiv-2302-09796.description: Abstract We initiate the study of matroid problems in a new oracle model called dynamic oracle . Our algorithms in this model lead to new bounds for some classic problems, and a “unified” algorithm whose performance matches previous results developed in various papers for various problems.

arxiv-2310-18892.title: Macroscopic emulation of microscopic magnetic particle systems Journal: Journal of Magnetism and Magnetic Materials
arxiv-2310-18892.creator: Viesturs Spūlis, Daniels Gorovojs, Jānis Pudāns, Rolands Lopatko, Andris P. Stikuts, Mārtiņš Brics, Guntars Kitenbergs, Jānis Cīmurs
arxiv-2310-18892.description: Abstract In this work we show that macroscopic experiments can be used to investigate microscopic systems. Such macroscopic experiments enable testing the assumptions and results obtained by theoretical considerations or simulations that can not be obtained under microscope (e.g., the orientation of a spherical particle).

arxiv-2312-03920.title: Optimizing Closed Payment Networks on the Lightning Network: Dual Central Node Approach
arxiv-2312-03920.creator: Jeffy Yu
arxiv-2312-03920.description: Abstract \footertext 1 1. Introduction In the rapidly evolving landscape of financial technology, the quest for efficient, secure, and inclusive payment systems has led to significant innovations. Among these, Bitcoin emerged as a groundbreaking digital currency, leveraging blockchain technology to facilitate peer-to-peer transactions without the need for traditional financial intermediaries [1].

arxiv-2402-17051.title: Wave Propagation in Periodic Plasma Media: A Semiclassical Approach
arxiv-2402-17051.description: Abstract The propagation of electromagnetic waves in unmagnetized periodic plasma media is studied using the semiclassical wave packet approximation. The formalism gives rise to Berry effect terms in the equation of motion. The Berry effect manifests itself as Rytov polarization rotation law and the polarization-dependent Hall effect. The formalism is also applied to the case of non-periodic inhomogeneous plasma media.

arxiv-2405-12855.title: Efficient explicit gate construction of block-encoding for Hamiltonians needed for simulating partial differential equations
arxiv-2405-12855.creator: Nikita Guseynov, Xiajie Huang, Nana Liu
arxiv-2405-12855.description: Abstract One of the most promising applications of quantum computers is solving partial differential equations (PDEs). By using the Schrödingerisation technique — which converts non-conservative PDEs into Schrödinger equations – the problem can be reduced to Hamiltonian simulations. The particular class of Hamiltonians we consider is shown to be sufficient for simulating almost any linear PDE.

arxiv-2406-17734.title: Non-periodic not everywhere dense trajectories in triangular billiards
arxiv-2406-17734.creator: J. Slipantschuk, O.F. Bandtlow, W. Just
arxiv-2406-17734.description: Abstract . Building on tools that have been successfully used in the study of rational billiards, such as induced maps and interval exchange transformations, we provide a construction of a one-parameter family of isosceles triangles exhibiting non-periodic trajectories that are not everywhere dense.

arxiv-2505-12559.title: Semigroups on generalized Sobolev spaces associated with Laplacians with applications Stochastic PDEs with singular boundary conditions
arxiv-2505-12559.creator: Sergio Albeverio, Zdzisław Brzeźniak, Szymon Peszat
arxiv-2505-12559.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sergio Albeverio, Zdzisław Brzeźniak, Szymon Peszat. Laplacians associated with domains with singular boundary conditions and are considered together with semigroups on generalized Sobolev spaces, they generate. Applications are given to stochastic PDEs with singular boundary conditions. Introduction

The description of many dynamical systems in the material world, both by deterministic and stochastic methods, often has to take into account the natural presence of boundary conditions.

pmc-10722892.title: Temporary impact on medical system and effectiveness of mitigation strategies after COVID-19 policy adjustment in China: a modeling study
pmc-10722892.creator: Chitin Hon, Jingyi Liang, Ruihan Chen, Zhijie Lin, Yangqianxi Wang, Wei He, Ruibin Liu, Jiaxi Sun, Qianyin Li, Lixi Liang, Minyi Zhang, Zichen Chang, Yinqiu Guo, Wenting Zeng, Tie Liu, Arlindo L. Oliveira
pmc-10722892.description: BackgroundAs China amends its “zero COVID” strategy, a sudden increase in the number of infections may overwhelm medical resources and its impact has not been quantified. Specific mitigation strategies are needed to minimize disruption to the healthcare system and to prepare for the next possible epidemic in advance.

pmc-11331365.title: Lysophosphatidic acid improves development of porcine somatic cell nuclear transfer embryos
pmc-11331365.creator: Ling Sun, Tao Lin, Jae Eun Lee, So Yeon Kim, Ying Bai, Dong Il Jin
pmc-11331365.description: This study was conducted to investigate whether lysophosphatidic acid (LPA) could improve the development of porcine somatic cell nuclear transfer (SCNT) embryos. Porcine SCNT-derived embryos were cultured in chemically defined polyvinyl alcohol (PVA)-based porcine zygote medium (PZM)-4 without or with LPA, and the development, cell proliferation potential, apoptosis, and expression levels of pluripotent markers were evaluated.

pmc-11432813.title: Investigation of the Temperature and Horizontal Freezing Force of Loess in Three-Dimensional Freezing
pmc-11432813.creator: Yidan Yin, Fei Liu, Dongqi Tang, Longze Chen, Binbin Yang
pmc-11432813.description: Seasonal frozen soil has significant impacts on changes in soil mechanical properties, settlement, and damage to foundations. In order to study variations in the temperature and horizontal freezing force of loess during three-dimensional freezing, a three-dimensional freezing model test of loess was carried out.

pmc-11518722.title: Global burden of anemia and cause among children under five years 1990–2019: findings from the global burden of disease study 2019
pmc-11518722.creator: Yujuan Liu, Weifang Ren, Shuying Wang, Minmin Xiang, Shunxian Zhang, Feng Zhang
pmc-11518722.description: BackgroundAnemia represents a significant global health issue affecting numerous children and women, characterized by diminished hemoglobin levels that may impede cognitive and developmental progress. Although commonly attributed to iron deficiency, the etiology of anemia in this demographic is multifaceted, encompassing nutritional, genetic, and infectious contributors.

pmc-11529883.title: Landmark knowledge overrides optic flow in honeybee waggle dance distance estimation
pmc-11529883.creator: Randolf Menzel, C. Giovanni Galizia
pmc-11529883.description: Honeybees encode in their waggle dances the vector (distance and direction) of an outbound flight to a food source or a new nest site. Optic flow has been identified as the major source of information in the distance estimation. Additional components of distance estimation were also identified, e.g. the sequence of experienced landmarks.

pmc-11685523.title: Three-year Clinical Outcome of Root Canal Treatment Using a Single-cone Technique and Ceraseal Premixed Bioceramic Sealer: A Prospective Cohort Study
pmc-11685523.creator: Andrea SPINELLI, Fausto ZAMPARINI, Jacopo LENZI, Maria Giovanna GANDOLFI, Carlo PRATI
pmc-11685523.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the outcome of teeth filled with a single cone technique and a premixed bioceramic sealer at 3 years of follow-up.MethodsHealthy patients were consecutively treated by a cohort of postgraduate operators. Root canal filling procedures were performed with NiTi rotary instrumentation, while non-surgical retreatments were performed using NiTi reciprocating instruments.

pmc-12456081.title: Enantioselective desymmetrization strategy of prochiral 1,3-diols in natural product synthesis
pmc-12456081.creator: Lihua Wei, Rui Yang, Zhifeng Shi, Zhiqiang Ma, Yefeng Tang
pmc-12456081.description: Enantioselective desymmetrization is employed as a powerful tool for the creation of chiral centers. Within this scope, the enantioselective desymmetrization of prochiral 1,3-diols, which generates chiral centers by enantioselective functionalization of one hydroxy group, offers beneficial procedures for accessing diverse structural motifs.

pmc-12768614.title: PP-2024-44 Why Early Savings From Avoided-Reinterventions Matter: A Budget-Impact Analysis Of The Eluvia Drug-Eluting Stent Across Different Time Horizons
pmc-12768614.creator: Thathya V Ariyaratne, Nishath Altaf, Bibombe Patrice Mwipatayi, Abimbola Williams, Virginia Priest
pmc-12768614.description: IntroductionThe need for reintervention peaks one to three years after an index endovascular intervention. Updating the Australian budget impact model becomes imperative to understand the impact of Eluvia™ drug-eluting stents (DES) over Zilver® PTX® drug-coated stents. This study forecasted the economic impact of Eluvia stents across various time horizons.

pmc-12831961.title: Comparison of the Cariogenic Potential of Two Sweeteners, Stevia and Aspartame, Based on Bacterial Inhibition and pH Reduction
pmc-12831961.creator: Reshmi J, Shaniya Sain
pmc-12831961.description: Background and aimComplete elimination of dietary sugars is impractical, especially for children. Restricting sugar intake and substituting sucrose with less cariogenic alternatives are plausible solutions. This in vitro study aimed to compare the cariogenic potential of two sweeteners, aspartame and stevia, by evaluating their bacterial inhibition capacity and the salivary pH changes produced at fixed time intervals.

pmc-13010217.title: The Novel HLA Class II Alleles DRB1*15:03:06, DQB1*03:01:69 and DPB1*04:01:95 Identified in Brazilian Donors
pmc-13010217.creator: Augusto Cesar Soares dos Santos Júnior, Cintia Keilla Fabreti de Oliveira, Marcelo Iraja Mion, Lucas Rafael da Silva, Raquel Aparecida Fabreti‐Oliveira
pmc-13010217.description: Identification of the novel HLA alleles DRB1*15:03:06, DQB1*03:01:69 and DPB1*04:01:95 in Brazilian individuals.Keywords: Brazilian population, HLA class II, new allele, NGS, REDOME HLA class II polymorphism plays a central role in immune recognition and donor–recipient compatibility in solid organ and haematopoietic stem cell transplantation.

pmc-13374333.title: Asymmetric tripolar nerve cuff electrode designs for optimizing anodal block of myelinated fibers
pmc-13374333.creator: Daniel Tovbis, Ryan G. L. Koh, Rania Jeong, Paul B. Yoo
pmc-13374333.description: PurposeAnodal block is a common mechanism used to generate unidirectional activation of myelinated nerve fibers. However, nerve block is often inconsistent and difficult to achieve. In this study, we used a computational model to investigate electrode cuff designs that can be exploited to enhance anodal block.

pmc-13459236.title: Multi-epitope mRNA vaccine and protein vaccine protect mice against Toxoplasma gondii
pmc-13459236.creator: Yulin Cui, Hongnan Qu, Chunxue Zhou, Ziyue Liang, Bing Han, Huaiyu Zhou, Hua Cong
pmc-13459236.description: BackgroundToxoplasma gondii, an obligate intracellular protozoan parasite, infects almost one-third of the world’s population and all warm-blooded animals, posing a substantial threat to public health. Accordingly, the development of effective vaccines against T. gondii has become an urgent priority. In this study, we constructed a multi-epitope chimeric antigen T-SGR targeting three key protective antigens of T.
